title: Taqqoslash va farqlash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ikki variantni o‘xshashlik va farqlar tilidan, whereas, while va on the other hand yordamida aniq tuzilma bilan taqqoslab, xulosada o‘z tanlovingizni sabab bilan aytasiz.

vocab.uz: A ni B dan afzal ko‘rmoq

scenes.title: Taqqoslash va farqlash
board: Lesson 22: Compare and contrast
(Taqqoslash va farqlash)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda tinglaganda tafsilotlarni ushlashni mashq qildik: raqamlar, ismlar, sabablar. Bugun esa gapirishga qaytamiz va ingliz tilidagi eng foydali nutq turlaridan birini o‘rganamiz: ikki narsani taqqoslash va farqlash. Dars oxirida ikki variantni aniq tuzilma bilan solishtirasiz, oxirida o‘z tanlovingizni asoslab ayta olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again, and welcome. Today we are going to learn how to compare and contrast two options clearly, and how to finish by saying which one you prefer.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom, xush kelibsiz. Bugun ikki variantni aniq taqqoslashni va oxirida qaysi birini afzal ko‘rishingizni aytishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Nega taqqoslaymiz?
board: Which is better: A or B?
similarities (o‘xshashliklar) · differences (farqlar)
+ your opinion (fikringiz)
scenes.say_native: Hayotda doim tanlaymiz: qaysi kvartira, qaysi ish, qaysi universitet. Imtihonda ham ko‘pincha ikki rasm yoki ikki variantni solishtirish so‘raladi. Yaxshi taqqoslash uch qismdan iborat: o‘xshashliklar, farqlar va oxirida sizning shaxsiy xulosangiz. Faqat ro‘yxat tuzish yetarli emas, fikrlarni bog‘laydigan tilni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: When people compare two things, they do three jobs. They show what is similar, they show what is different, and they give a final opinion.
scenes.say_uz: Odamlar ikki narsani taqqoslaganda uchta ish qiladi: o‘xshashlikni ko‘rsatadi, farqni ko‘rsatadi va oxirgi fikrini aytadi.

scenes.title: O‘xshashlik: both va too
board: both A and B (ikkalasi ham)
A is ... too / as well / also
neither A nor B (ikkalasi ham emas)

examples.t: Both London and Tashkent are big cities.
examples.uz: London ham, Toshkent ham katta shaharlar.

examples.t: London is expensive, and Paris is too.

scenes.say_native: Avval o‘xshashliklar. Eng oddiy qolip: ‘both A and B’ — A ham, B ham. Fe’l ko‘plikda keladi: ‘Both cities are busy.’ Ikkinchi usul: gap oxiriga ‘too’ yoki ‘as well’ qo‘yamiz: ‘My brother plays tennis, and I do too.’ Salbiy ma’noda esa ‘neither A nor B’ ishlatamiz, lekin fe’l o‘zi ijobiy shaklda turadi: ‘Neither city is cheap.’ O‘zbekchadagi ‘ham... ham’ ga to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say: Both London and Tashkent are big cities. London is expensive, and Paris is too. Neither city is cheap.
scenes.say_uz: London ham, Toshkent ham katta shaharlar. London qimmat, Parij ham. Hech biri arzon emas.

scenes.title: O‘xshashlik: the same as, similar to, like
board: A is the same as B
A is similar to B
A is like B · A and B have ... in common

examples.t: My phone is the same as yours.
Her job is similar to mine.

scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta foydali iboraga e’tibor bering. ‘The same as’ — aynan bir xil: ‘This is the same as that.’ ‘Similar to’ — o‘xshash, lekin aynan bir xil emas. ‘Like’ — ‘kabi’, ‘singari’ degani. ‘Have something in common’ — umumiy jihati bor: ‘We have a lot in common.’
scenes.say: My phone is the same as yours. Her job is similar to mine. We both love music, so we have a lot in common.
scenes.say_uz: Mening telefonim seniknidek. Uning ishi menikiga o‘xshash. Ikkimiz ham musiqani yaxshi ko‘ramiz, shuning uchun bizda ko‘p umumiy jihat bor.

scenes.title: O‘xshashlikdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Both are not expensive.
✓ Neither is expensive.
✗ It is same like mine.
✓ It is the same as mine.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tipik xato. Birinchisi: ‘Both are not expensive.’ Bu gap noaniq eshitiladi, ko‘pincha ‘ikkalasi ham qimmat emas’ degan ma’noni bermaydi. To‘g‘ri variant: ‘Neither is expensive’ yoki ‘Both are cheap.’ Ikkinchisi: ‘same like’. Bunda o‘zbekcha ‘xuddi shunday’ ta’sir qiladi. Ingliz tilida ‘the same as’ deymiz, ‘like’ emas. Bu so‘z oldidan ‘the’ ni tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: Not: both are not expensive. Say: neither is expensive. And not same like, but the same as.
scenes.say_uz: Both are not expensive emas, neither is expensive deng. Same like emas, the same as deng.

scenes.title: O‘xshashlik gaplari
board: 1) Tea is popular. Coffee is popular. → Both ...
2) My bag is big. Yours is big. → ... too
3) Dog and cat are not noisy. → Neither ...
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi uch juftlikni berilgan qolip bo‘yicha bitta gapga aylantiring. Birinchisini ‘both’ bilan boshlang, ikkinchisini ‘too’ bilan tugating, uchinchisini ‘neither’ bilan boshlang. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Combine each pair. One: tea and coffee. Two: my bag and yours. Three: the dog and the cat, not noisy.
scenes.say_uz: Har juftlikni birlashtiring. Bir: choy va kofe. Ikki: mening sumkam va seniki. Uch: it va mushuk, shovqinli emas.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Both tea and coffee are popular.
2) My bag is big, and yours is too.
3) Neither the dog nor the cat is noisy.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ‘Both tea and coffee are popular.’ Ikkinchi: ‘My bag is big, and yours is too.’ Uchinchi: ‘Neither the dog nor the cat is noisy.’ Oxirgi gapda fe’l odatda ikkinchi ismga moslashadi, bu yerda ikkalasi ham birlikda, shuning uchun ‘is’.
scenes.say: Both tea and coffee are popular. My bag is big, and yours is too. Neither the dog nor the cat is noisy.
scenes.say_uz: Choy ham, kofe ham mashhur. Mening sumkam katta, seniki ham. Na it, na mushuk shovqinli.

scenes.title: Farq: different from, unlike
board: A is different from B
Unlike A, B ... (A dan farqli o‘laroq)
the difference between A and B

examples.t: My town is very different from yours.
examples.uz: Mening shahrim seniknidan juda farq qiladi.

examples.t: Unlike Tashkent, my village is quiet.
examples.uz: Toshkentdan farqli o‘laroq, mening qishlog‘im sokin.

scenes.say_native: Endi farqlar. ‘Different from’ — ‘...dan farq qiladi’. Britaniya ingliz tilida ‘different to’ ham uchraydi, amerikaliklar esa ko‘pincha ‘different than’ deydi, lekin ‘different from’ hamma joyda to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi. ‘Unlike’ gapni boshlaydi va ‘...dan farqli o‘laroq’ degan ma’noni beradi: ‘Unlike Tashkent, my village is quiet.’ Yana ‘the difference between A and B’ — A va B orasidagi farq.
scenes.say: My town is very different from yours. Unlike Tashkent, my village is quiet. The difference between them is size.
scenes.say_uz: Mening shahrim seniknidan juda farq qiladi. Toshkentdan farqli o‘laroq, mening qishlog‘im sokin. Ular orasidagi farq o‘lchamida.

scenes.title: Farqni darajalash
board: much / far / a lot + -er than
a bit / slightly + -er than
not as ... as · less ... than

examples.t: Cities are far noisier than villages.
The bus is not as fast as the train.

scenes.say_native: Farqni aytganda uning kattaligini ham ko‘rsatish kerak. Katta farq uchun ‘much’, ‘far’ yoki ‘a lot’ qo‘yamiz: ‘far noisier than’. Kichik farq uchun ‘a bit’ yoki ‘slightly’. Salbiy qolip ham bor: ‘not as fast as’ — ‘...day tez emas’ yoki ‘less expensive than’.
scenes.say: Cities are far noisier than villages. The train is slightly more expensive than the bus, but it is not as slow. Life here is a bit less stressful.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar qishloqlardan ancha shovqinliroq. Poyezd avtobusdan biroz qimmatroq, lekin u unchalik sekin emas. Bu yerda hayot bir oz kam stressli.

scenes.title: Farqdagi xatolar
board: ✗ more bigger · ✓ bigger
✗ different than me · ✓ different from me
✗ bigger that · ✓ bigger than
✗ very bigger · ✓ much bigger
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta tipik xato. Birinchi: ‘more bigger’ — qo‘sh qiyoslash. Faqat bittasi kerak: ‘bigger’. Ikkinchi: ‘different than’ — standart yozuvda ‘different from’ xavfsizroq. Uchinchi: ‘bigger that’ — oddiy imlo xatosi, to‘g‘risi ‘than’. To‘rtinchi: ‘very bigger’. Qiyoslash bilan ‘very’ ishlatilmaydi, ‘much’ yoki ‘far’ ishlatiladi. O‘zbekchada ‘juda kattaroq’ desak ham bo‘ladi, ingliz tilida esa yo‘q.
scenes.say: Not more bigger, but bigger. Not very bigger, but much bigger. And remember: bigger than, different from.
scenes.say_uz: More bigger emas, bigger. Very bigger emas, much bigger. Esda tuting: bigger than, different from.

scenes.title: Farqlarni ayting
board: 1) Tashkent / my village: size
2) Bus / train: speed
3) Tea / coffee: price
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har juftlik uchun bitta gap tuzing va farqning kattaligini ko‘rsating. Birinchi: Toshkent va sizning qishlog‘ingiz, o‘lchami. Ikkinchi: avtobus va poyezd, tezligi. Uchinchi: choy va kofe, narxi. Masalan: ‘Tashkent is much bigger than my village.’ Boshqa gaplarni o‘zingiz tuzing.
scenes.say: Make a sentence for each pair. Remember to show how big the difference is.
scenes.say_uz: Har juftlik uchun gap tuzing. Farq qanchalik katta ekanini ko‘rsatishni unutmang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Tashkent is much bigger than my village.
2) The bus is not as fast as the train.
3) Coffee is slightly more expensive than tea.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: ‘Tashkent is much bigger than my village.’ Ikkinchi: ‘The bus is not as fast as the train’ yoki ‘The train is far faster than the bus.’ Uchinchi: ‘Coffee is slightly more expensive than tea.’ Sizniki biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi ‘than’ yoki ‘as... as’
scenes.say: Tashkent is much bigger than my village. The bus is not as fast as the train. Coffee is slightly more expensive than tea.
scenes.say_uz: Toshkent mening qishlog‘imdan ancha katta. Avtobus poyezdday tez emas. Kofe choydan biroz qimmatroq.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
board: ...ga qaraganda → than / compared with
..., esa → whereas / while
lekin → but (oddiy)
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida taqqoslash uchun ‘...ga qaraganda’, ‘...dan ko‘ra’ kabi qo‘shimcha va yordamchi so‘zlar ishlatamiz. Ingliz tilida ular o‘rniga ‘than’ yoki ‘compared with’ turadi va so‘z tartibi teskari: ‘Shahar qishloqqa qaraganda shovqinli’ degani ‘The city is noisier than the village’. Qarama-qarshilik uchun o‘zbekchada ‘esa’ yuklamasi bor: ‘Shaharda shovqin, qishloqda esa sukunat’. Aynan shu ‘esa’ ga ingliz tilida ‘whereas’ va ‘while’ mos keladi.
scenes.say: In Uzbek you say shaharga qaraganda, and the word order is different. In English we say: than the city. And for esa, we use whereas or while.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekchada ‘shaharga qaraganda’ deysiz va so‘z tartibi boshqacha. Inglizchada ‘than the city’ deymiz. ‘Esa’ uchun whereas yoki while ishlatamiz.

scenes.title: Whereas va while
board: A is ..., whereas B is ...
While A is ..., B is ...
(comma — doim vergul)

examples.t: Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet.
While cities are noisy, villages are quiet.

scenes.say_native: Endi bugungi birinchi asosiy qolip: ‘whereas’ va ‘while’. Ikkalasi ham ikki to‘liq gapni bog‘lab, qarama-qarshilikni ko‘rsatadi. Ular o‘rtada ham, boshida ham turishi mumkin. O‘rtada: ‘Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet.’ Boshida: ‘While cities are noisy, villages are quiet.’ Ikkala holatda ham ikki qism orasiga vergul qo‘yiladi. ‘Whereas’ rasmiyroq, ‘while’ esa og‘zaki nutqda ko‘proq uchraydi.
scenes.say: Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet. While cities are noisy, villages are quiet. My sister loves the city, whereas I prefer the countryside.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar shovqinli, qishloqlar esa sokin. Singlim shaharni yaxshi ko‘radi, men esa qishloqni afzal ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Whereas bilan xatolar
board: ✗ Whereas cities are noisy, but villages are quiet.
✓ Whereas cities are noisy, villages are quiet.
✗ Cities are noisy. Whereas villages are quiet.
✓ Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita juda tipik xato. Birinchisi: ‘whereas’ yoki ‘while’ bilan birga ‘but’ ishlatish. Ikkisi bir xil vazifani bajaradi, shuning uchun faqat bittasi kerak. O‘zbekchada ‘esa, lekin’ ni birga ishlatib bo‘lardi, inglizchada yo‘q. Ikkinchisi: ‘whereas’ dan oldin nuqta qo‘yib, uni alohida gap qilib yuborish. Bu to‘liq gap emas, bo‘laklangan gap bo‘lib qoladi. Nuqta emas, vergul ishlating.
scenes.say: Do not use but with whereas. And do not put a full stop before whereas. Use a comma.
scenes.say_uz: Whereas bilan but ishlatmang. Whereas oldiga nuqta qo‘ymang. Vergul ishlating.

scenes.title: Ikki gapni birlashtiring
board: 1) Summer is hot. Winter is cold. (whereas)
2) I like tea. My father likes coffee. (while)
3) Trains are fast. Buses are cheap. (whereas)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har juftlik gapni berilgan so‘z bilan bitta gapga aylantiring. Birinchi: yoz issiq, qish sovuq, ‘whereas’ bilan. Ikkinchi: men choyni yaxshi ko‘raman, otam kofeni, ‘while’ bilan boshlang. Uchinchi: poyezdlar tez, avtobuslar arzon, yana ‘whereas’. Vergulni unutmang.
scenes.say: Join each pair. One: summer and winter, with whereas. Two: tea and coffee, with while. Three: trains and buses, with whereas.
scenes.say_uz: Har juftlikni birlashtiring. Bir: yoz va qish, whereas bilan. Ikki: choy va kofe, while bilan. Uch: poyezd va avtobus, whereas bilan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Summer is hot, whereas winter is cold.
2) While I like tea, my father likes coffee.
3) Trains are fast, whereas buses are cheap.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ‘Summer is hot, whereas winter is cold.’ Ikkinchi: ‘While I like tea, my father likes coffee.’ Uchinchi: ‘Trains are fast, whereas buses are cheap.’ Har uchala gapda vergul bor va ‘but’ yo‘q. Agar ikkinchi gapni ‘While my father likes coffee, I like tea’
scenes.say: Summer is hot, whereas winter is cold. While I like tea, my father likes coffee. Trains are fast, whereas buses are cheap.
scenes.say_uz: Yoz issiq, qish esa sovuq. Men choyni yoqtirsam, otam kofeni yoqtiradi. Poyezdlar tez, avtobuslar esa arzon.

scenes.title: On the one hand... on the other hand
board: On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...
On the other hand, ... (ikkinchi fikr)
Vergul doim keyin

examples.t: On the one hand, cities offer more jobs. On the other hand, they are very expensive.
examples.uz: Bir tomondan, shaharlar ko‘proq ish taklif qiladi. Ikkinchi tomondan, ular juda qimmat.

scenes.say_native: Endi uchinchi vosita: ‘on the other hand’ — ikkinchi tomondan. Bu ibora bir fikrning ikki tomonini ko‘rsatadi, ko‘pincha avval ‘on the one hand’, ya’ni bir tomondan, deb boshlaymiz. ‘On the one hand, cities offer more jobs. On the other hand, they are very expensive.’ Ibora yangi gapni boshlaydi va undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Ba’zan birinchi qism tushib qoladi va faqat ‘on the other hand’ ishlatiladi, bu ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: On the one hand, cities offer more jobs. On the other hand, they are very expensive. The countryside is cheaper. On the other hand, there are fewer opportunities.
scenes.say_uz: Bir tomondan, shaharlar ko‘proq ish taklif qiladi. Ikkinchi tomondan, ular juda qimmat. Qishloq arzonroq. Boshqa tomondan, imkoniyatlar kamroq.

scenes.title: However, in contrast, by contrast
board: However, ... (biroq)
In contrast, ... / By contrast, ... (aksincha)
...; however, ... · ..., although ...

examples.t: The flat is cheap. However, it is far from work.
In contrast, the house is close to the station.

scenes.say_native: Yana ikkita tanishuv. ‘However’ — biroq, lekin. Odatda gap boshida turadi va vergul bilan ajratiladi. ‘In contrast’ va ‘by contrast’ — aksincha, farqli o‘laroq, ikki narsani to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qarama-qarshi qo‘yganda ishlatiladi. Farqi: ‘however’ kutilmagan teskari fikrni, ‘on the other hand’ ikkinchi tomonni, ‘in contrast’ esa to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri zid narsani bildiradi. Nuqtali vergul bilan ‘; however,’ ham ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: The flat is cheap. However, it is far from work. The house is expensive. In contrast, it is close to the station.
scenes.say_uz: Kvartira arzon. Biroq, ishdan uzoq. Uy qimmat. Aksincha, u bekatga yaqin.

scenes.title: Linker xatolari
board: ✗ In the other hand, ...
✓ On the other hand, ...
✗ However the flat is cheap.
✓ However, the flat is cheap.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: ‘in the other hand’. Ibora qat’iy, faqat ‘on the other hand’ deyiladi. Ikkinchisi: ‘however’ dan keyin vergul qo‘yishni unutish. Uchinchisi: ‘on the contrary’ ni oddiy taqqoslashda ishlatish. Bu ibora boshqa ma’noga ega, u oldingi gapni inkor etadi, ikkinchi tomonni qo‘shmaydi.
scenes.say: Say on the other hand, not in the other hand. Put a comma after however. And do not use on the contrary for ordinary contrast.
scenes.say_uz: On the other hand deng, in the other hand emas. However dan keyin vergul qo‘ying. On the contrary ni oddiy taqqoslashda ishlatmang.

scenes.title: Linkerni tanlang
board: 1) The hotel is nice. ___, it is expensive.
2) Cats sleep a lot, ___ dogs need walks.
3) ___ the one hand, I love the sea. ___ the other hand, I get seasick.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joylarga mos so‘zni tanlang. Birinchi gap: mehmonxona chiroyli. ... qimmat. Ikkinchi gap: mushuklar ko‘p uxlaydi, ... itlarni sayr qildirish kerak. Uchinchi gap: bir tomondan dengizni yaxshi ko‘raman, ikkinchi tomondan ... Nima qo‘yasiz? Linkerlarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the best linker for each gap: however, whereas, on, or on the other.
scenes.say_uz: Har bo‘sh joy uchun eng mos linkerni tanlang: however, whereas, on yoki on the other.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) However,
2) whereas
3) On ... On
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap: ‘The hotel is nice. However, it is expensive.’ Ikkinchi gap: ‘Cats sleep a lot, whereas dogs need walks.’ Uchinchi gap: ‘On the one hand, I love the sea. On the other hand, I get seasick.’ Birinchisini ‘On the other hand’ bilan ham to‘ldirsa bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The hotel is nice. However, it is expensive. Cats sleep a lot, whereas dogs need walks. On the one hand, I love the sea. On the other hand, I get seasick.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxona chiroyli. Biroq, qimmat. Mushuklar ko‘p uxlaydi, itlarni esa sayr qildirish kerak. Bir tomondan dengizni yaxshi ko‘raman. Ikkinchi tomondan, mening ko‘nglim aynaydi.

scenes.title: Taqqoslashni tuzish: ikki usul
board: 1) Block: all about A, then all about B
2) Point-by-point: cost → A and B; size → A and B
Point-by-point = ko‘pincha aniqroq
scenes.say_native: Endi tuzilma. Taqqoslashni ikki usulda qurish mumkin. Birinchisi — blok usuli: avval A haqida hamma narsani aytasiz, keyin B haqida. Bu oson, lekin tinglovchi o‘zi solishtirishi kerak bo‘ladi. Ikkinchisi — nuqtama-nuqta usuli: har bir mezon bo‘yicha, masalan narx, hajm, qulaylik, A va B ni yonma-yon qo‘yasiz. Bu qiyinroq, lekin taqqoslash aniq ko‘rinadi. Imtihon uchun odatda ikkinchisi yaxshiroq, chunki u ko‘proq bog‘lovchi til talab qiladi.
scenes.say: There are two ways to organise a comparison. In the block method, you talk about A and then B. In the point-by-point method, you compare A and B on one point at a time.
scenes.say_uz: Taqqoslashni tuzishning ikki usuli bor. Blok usulida avval A, keyin B haqida gapirasiz. Nuqtama-nuqta usulida bir vaqtda bitta mezon bo‘yicha A va B ni solishtirasiz.

scenes.title: Namuna: nuqtama-nuqta
board: Opening → Point 1 → Point 2 → Conclusion
Firstly / In terms of / As for
Overall, I would choose ...
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna: shahar va qishloq. Diqqat qiling, bu javob uch qismdan iborat: kirish, mezonlar bo‘yicha taqqoslash va xulosa. Kirishda ikki variantni nomlaymiz. Keyin ‘in terms of’ yoki ‘as for’ kabi iboralar bilan har bir mezonga o‘tamiz. Har mezonda ham o‘xshashlik, ham farq bor. Nihoyat, ‘overall’ so‘zi bilan xulosaga o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: Let me compare city life and country life. In terms of jobs, cities offer far more opportunities, whereas villages offer fewer. As for the environment, the countryside is cleaner and quieter. Overall, I would choose the city while I am young.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar va qishloq hayotini solishtiray. Ish bo‘yicha shaharlar ancha ko‘p imkoniyat beradi, qishloqlar esa kamroq. Atrof-muhit bo‘yicha qishloq toza va sokin. Umuman olganda, yoshligimda shaharni tanlagan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Reja tuzing
board: Online lessons vs classroom lessons
Choose 3 points: cost, speed, speaking
For each point: A ... whereas B ...
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mavzu: onlayn darslar va sinfdagi darslar. Uchta mezon tanlang: narx, qulaylik va gapirish mashqi. Har bir mezon uchun bitta taqqoslash gapini tuzing, ichida ‘whereas’ yoki ‘while’ bo‘lsin. Birinchi gap ‘When it comes to cost’ bilan boshlansin. Gaplarni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Compare online and classroom lessons. Use three points: cost, convenience and speaking practice. Start with: when it comes to cost.
scenes.say_uz: Onlayn va sinfdagi darslarni solishtiring. Uchta mezon: narx, qulaylik va gapirish mashqi. Boshlang: when it comes to cost.

scenes.title: Namunaviy reja
board: Cost: online is cheaper, whereas classes are dearer
Convenience: online is flexible, while classes have fixed times
Speaking: classes give more practice
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy variant. Narx: ‘When it comes to cost, online lessons are cheaper, whereas classroom lessons are more expensive.’ Qulaylik: ‘In terms of convenience, online lessons are flexible, while classroom lessons have fixed times.’ Gapirish: ‘As for speaking practice, classroom lessons usually give more chances to talk.’ Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin.
scenes.say: When it comes to cost, online lessons are cheaper, whereas classroom lessons are more expensive. In terms of convenience, online lessons are flexible, while classes have fixed times.
scenes.say_uz: Narxga kelsak, onlayn darslar arzonroq, sinfdagi darslar esa qimmatroq. Qulaylik jihatidan onlayn darslar moslashuvchan, sinfdagilar esa qat’iy vaqtga ega.

scenes.title: Xulosa: afzal ko‘rishni aytish
board: Overall, / All things considered, / On balance,
I'd prefer A to B because ...
I'd rather do A than B. · I'd choose A.

examples.t: All things considered, I would choose the countryside.
examples.uz: Hammasini hisobga olib, men qishloqni tanlagan bo‘lardim.

examples.t: I'd rather live in a village than in a big city.
examples.uz: Katta shaharda yashagandan ko‘ra qishloqda yashashni afzal ko‘raman.

scenes.say_native: Taqqoslash xulosasiz tugamasligi kerak. Xulosani signal so‘zlar bilan boshlaymiz: ‘overall’ — umuman olganda, ‘all things considered’ — hammasini hisobga olib, ‘on balance’ — hammasini tortib ko‘rib. Keyin tanlovni aytamiz: ‘I’d choose A’ yoki ‘I’d prefer A to B’ yoki ‘I’d rather do A than B’. Muhim: ‘because’ bilan sababni qo‘shing. Sababsiz tanlov kuchsiz eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Overall, I would choose the countryside. I would prefer a quiet village to a busy city, because I enjoy fresh air. I would rather live there than in a crowded city.
scenes.say_uz: Umuman olganda, men qishloqni tanlagan bo‘lardim. Gavjum shahardan ko‘ra sokin qishloqni afzal ko‘raman, chunki toza havoni yaxshi ko‘raman. U yerda yashashni gavjum shaharda yashashdan ko‘ra afzal ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Prefer va would rather xatolari
board: ✗ I prefer city than village.
✓ I prefer the city to the village.
✗ I'd rather to live in a village.
✓ I'd rather live in a village (than ...).
scenes.say_native: Prefer bilan xato: ‘prefer than’. To‘g‘risi ‘prefer A to B’, ya’ni ‘to’ bilan. Chunki o‘zbekcha ‘...dan ko‘ra’ ni ‘than’ deb o‘ylab yuboramiz. Ikkinchi xato: ‘I’d rather to live’. ‘Would rather’ dan keyin ‘to’ siz asosiy shakl keladi: ‘I’d rather live’. Agar ikkinchi variantni ham aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, ‘than’ ishlating: ‘I’d rather live in a village than in a city.’ Qoidani eslab qoling: prefer bilan ‘to’, would rather bilan ‘than’.
scenes.say: I prefer coffee to tea. I'd rather stay at home than go out. Not prefer than. Not rather to.
scenes.say_uz: Men kofeni choydan afzal ko‘raman. Tashqariga chiqqandan ko‘ra uyda qolishni afzal ko‘raman. Prefer than emas. Rather to emas.

scenes.title: Tanlovingizni ayting
board: 1) a flat or a house?  (prefer ... to ...)
2) bus or taxi?  (I'd rather ... than ...)
3) summer or winter?  (Overall, I'd choose ... because ...)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta tanlov. Birinchi: kvartira yoki uy? ‘I prefer... to...’ bilan javob bering. Ikkinchi: avtobus yoki taksi? ‘I’d rather... than...’ bilan javob bering. Uchinchi: yoz yoki qish? ‘Overall, I’d choose...’ deb boshlang va ‘because’ bilan sabab qo‘shing. O‘z fikringiz bo‘yicha javob bering, to‘g‘ri-xato javob yo‘q.
scenes.say: Make three choices. A flat or a house? Bus or taxi? Summer or winter? Use the structures on the board.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta tanlov qiling. Kvartira yoki uy? Avtobus yoki taksi? Yoz yoki qish? Taxtadagi qoliplardan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javoblar
board: 1) I prefer a flat to a house.
2) I'd rather take a bus than a taxi.
3) Overall, I'd choose summer because I love long days.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: ‘I prefer a flat to a house, because it is easier to clean.’ Ikkinchi: ‘I’d rather take a bus than a taxi, because it is cheaper.’ Uchinchi: ‘Overall, I’d choose summer because I love long days.’ Sizning tanlovingiz boshqa bo‘lsa ham, mantiq bir xil: tanlov, so‘ng sabab.
scenes.say: I prefer a flat to a house, because it is easier to clean. I'd rather take a bus than a taxi, because it is cheaper. Overall, I'd choose summer because I love long days.
scenes.say_uz: Men kvartirani uydan afzal ko‘raman, chunki tozalash oson. Taksidan ko‘ra avtobusda yurishni afzal ko‘raman, chunki arzonroq. Umuman, yozni tanlayman, chunki uzun kunlarni yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Tinglang: ikki kvartira
board: Listen. (Tinglang)
Which flat is cheaper?
What is good about Park Road?
Which flat does Tom choose, and why?
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st, Maya va Tom, Tom ko‘rgan ikki kvartirani muhokama qilmoqda. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob berasiz: qaysi kvartira arzonroq, Park Road ning qanday afzalliklari bor, va Tom qaysi birini va nega tanlaydi. Taqqoslash tilini eshitishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Which flat did you prefer, Tom? Well, the Park Road one is bigger, but it costs nine hundred pounds a month, whereas the station flat is only seven hundred. Is it noisy there? A bit. Park Road is quiet. On the other hand, the station flat is five minutes from my office. So, which one will you take? Overall, the station flat. Saving time matters more to me than having space.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi kvartira senga ko‘proq yoqdi, Tom? Park Road dagisi kattaroq, lekin oyiga to‘qqiz yuz funt turadi, bekat yonidagisi esa atigi yetti yuz. U yerda shovqin bormi? Biroz. Park Road tinch. Boshqa tomondan, bekat yonidagi kvartira ofisimdan besh daqiqalik masofada. Qaysi birini olasan? Umuman olganda, bekat yonidagisini. Vaqtni tejash men uchun joydan muhimroq.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) Which flat is cheaper?
2) What is good about Park Road?
3) Which flat does Tom choose, and why?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: qaysi kvartira arzonroq? Ikkinchi: Park Road ning yaxshi tomoni nima, kamida ikkitasini ayting. Uchinchi: Tom qaysi kvartirani tanlaydi va sababi nima? Javoblaringizni to‘liq gap bilan baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Three questions. Which flat is cheaper? What is good about Park Road? Which flat does Tom choose, and why?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Qaysi kvartira arzonroq? Park Road ning yaxshi tomoni nima? Tom qaysi kvartirani tanlaydi va nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The station flat: £700, not £900
2) Park Road: bigger and quieter
3) The station flat: it is close to the office; time matters more
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: bekat yonidagi kvartira arzonroq, yetti yuz funt, Park Road esa to‘qqiz yuz. Ikkinchi: Park Road kattaroq va tinchroq. Uchinchi: Tom bekat yonidagi kvartirani tanlaydi, chunki u ofisga besh daqiqalik masofada va Tom uchun vaqt joydan muhimroq. E’tibor bering, Tom ‘whereas’, ‘on the other hand’ va ‘overall’
scenes.say: The station flat is cheaper. Park Road is bigger and quieter. Tom chooses the station flat, because it is close to his office.
scenes.say_uz: Bekat yonidagi kvartira arzonroq. Park Road kattaroq va tinchroq. Tom bekat yonidagi kvartirani tanlaydi, chunki u ofisiga yaqin.

scenes.title: Tinglang: ikki ish taklifi
board: Listen. (Tinglang)
What does the bank offer?
Why might the start-up be risky?
How many days can Ben work from home?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki hamkasb, Anna va Ben, Benning ikki ish taklifi haqida gaplashmoqda: bank va yangi kichik kompaniya. Tinglang va quyidagilarni aniqlang: bank nima taklif qiladi, nega yangi kompaniya xavfliroq va Ben haftasiga necha kun uyda ishlay oladi. Ben qaysi birini tanlashini ham eshitasiz.
scenes.say: Ben, I heard you have two job offers. Yes. The bank pays more, while the start-up gives me more freedom. How do you mean? At the bank I would work in the office every day. At the start-up I could work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. But isn't a start-up riskier? It is. On the other hand, I would learn much faster there. All things considered, I'd rather take the start-up than stay safe.
scenes.say_uz: Ben, eshitdimki, senda ikkita ish taklifi bor. Ha. Bank ko‘proq to‘laydi, yangi kompaniya esa menga ko‘proq erkinlik beradi. Qanday ma’noda? Bankda har kuni ofisda ishlayman. Yangi kompaniyada chorshanba va juma kunlari uyda ishlay olaman. Lekin yangi kompaniya xavfliroq emasmi? Ha. Boshqa tomondan, u yerda ancha tez o‘rganaman. Hammasini hisobga olib, xavfsiz yo‘ldan ko‘ra yangi kompaniyani tanlagan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What does the bank offer?
2) Why is the start-up risky?
3) Ben works from home on ... days.
4) Which job does Ben prefer?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Birinchi: bank nima taklif qiladi? Ikkinchi: nega yangi kompaniya xavfliroq? Uchinchi: Ben haftasiga necha kun va qaysi kunlari uyda ishlay oladi? To‘rtinchi: u qaysi ishni tanlaydi va nima uchun? Kalit iboralarni yozib qo‘ying va javob bering.
scenes.say: Four questions. What does the bank offer? Why is the start-up risky? On which days can Ben work from home? Which job does he prefer?
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bank nima taklif qiladi? Nega yangi kompaniya xavfli? Ben qaysi kunlari uyda ishlay oladi? U qaysi ishni afzal ko‘radi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The bank pays more.
2) A start-up is riskier (less secure).
3) Two days: Wednesday and Friday
4) The start-up: more freedom, faster learning
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: bank ko‘proq maosh to‘laydi. Ikkinchi: yangi kompaniya xavfliroq, chunki unchalik barqaror emas. Uchinchi: ikki kun, chorshanba va juma. To‘rtinchi: Ben yangi kompaniyani tanlaydi, chunki u yerda erkinlik ko‘proq va tezroq o‘rganadi. Ben xulosani ‘all things considered, I’d rather... than...’ bilan qildi.
scenes.say: The bank pays more. A start-up is riskier. Ben can work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. He prefers the start-up because he wants freedom and faster learning.
scenes.say_uz: Bank ko‘proq to‘laydi. Yangi kompaniya xavfliroq. Ben chorshanba va juma kunlari uyda ishlay oladi. U yangi kompaniyani afzal ko‘radi, chunki erkinlik va tezroq o‘rganishni xohlaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: zid so‘zlarga urg‘u
board: Cities are NOISY, whereas villages are QUIET.
than /ðən/ · as /əz/ · and /ən/ (weak)
On the other HAND ↘
scenes.say_native: Taqqoslashda ohang juda muhim. Zid so‘zlarga, ya’ni ma’noni olib yuruvchi so‘zlarga kuchli urg‘u beramiz: ‘Cities are NOISY, whereas villages are QUIET.’ Kichik grammatik so‘zlar esa zaif talaffuz qilinadi: ‘than’ ko‘pincha ‘dhen’ ga yaqin, shva bilan, ‘as’ ham ‘ez’ kabi. ‘Than’ ni ‘dan’ deb to‘liq aytsangiz, sun’iy eshitiladi. Yana: ‘on the other hand’ da asosiy urg‘u ‘hand’ da, ovoz pasayadi.
scenes.say: Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet. The bus is cheaper than the train. It is not as fast as the train. On the other hand, it is more relaxing.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar shovqinli, qishloqlar esa sokin. Avtobus poyezddan arzonroq. U poyezdday tez emas. Boshqa tomondan, u tinchroq.

scenes.title: Urg‘u bilan takrorlang
board: Cities are NOISY, whereas villages are QUIET.
The bus is CHEAPER than the train.
On the other HAND, it is SLOWER.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Uch gapni zid so‘zlarga kuchli urg‘u berib ayting. Zaif so‘zlar, ya’ni ‘are’, ‘than’, ‘the’ tez va yengil bo‘lsin. Avval sekin, keyin oqimli takrorlang. Ovoz balandligiga emas, aniqlikka e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet. The bus is cheaper than the train. On the other hand, it is slower.
scenes.say_uz: Shaharlar shovqinli, qishloqlar esa sokin. Avtobus poyezddan arzonroq. Boshqa tomondan, u sekinroq.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bus yoki train
board: Compare travelling by bus and by train
Use: both, whereas/while, on the other hand
End: Overall, I'd choose ... because ...
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Yarim daqiqa davomida avtobusda va poyezdda sayohat qilishni solishtiring. Kamida bitta o‘xshashlik ayting, ‘both’ bilan. Keyin ikki farq, ‘whereas’ yoki ‘while’ va ‘on the other hand’ bilan. Oxirida ‘Overall, I’d choose...’ deb tanlovingizni sabab bilan ayting. Tayyor bo‘lsangiz, boshlang.
scenes.say: Compare travelling by bus and by train. Say one similarity, two differences, and your final choice. Start now.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobus va poyezdda sayohatni solishtiring. Bitta o‘xshashlik, ikkita farq va yakuniy tanlovni ayting. Hozir boshlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Both ... · whereas ... · on the other hand ...
Overall, I'd choose the train because ...
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. ‘Both buses and trains can take you across the country. The bus is cheaper, whereas the train is much faster. On the other hand, buses go to more places. Overall, I would choose the train for long journeys, because it is more comfortable.’ Sizning variantingizda o‘xshashlik, farqlar va xulosa bor edimi?
scenes.say: Both buses and trains can take you across the country. The bus is cheaper, whereas the train is much faster. On the other hand, buses go to more places. Overall, I would choose the train for long journeys, because it is more comfortable.
scenes.say_uz: Ham avtobus, ham poyezd sizni butun mamlakat bo‘ylab olib borishi mumkin. Avtobus arzonroq, poyezd esa ancha tez. Boshqa tomondan, avtobuslar ko‘proq joyga boradi. Umuman, uzoq yo‘llar uchun poyezdni tanlayman, chunki u qulayroq.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: both · neither · the same as · similar to
different from · unlike · than · not as ... as
whereas / while · on the other hand · however
Overall, I'd prefer A to B · I'd rather ... than ...
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. O‘xshashlik uchun ‘both’, ‘neither’, ‘too’, ‘the same as’, ‘similar to’ ni o‘rgandik. Farq uchun ‘different from’, ‘unlike’, ‘than’ va ‘not as... as’. Qarama-qarshilik uchun ‘whereas’, ‘while’, ‘on the other hand’ va ‘however’. Taqqoslashni nuqtama-nuqta tuzishni ham mashq qildik. Nihoyat, ‘overall’, ‘prefer to’, ‘would rather than’ bilan tanlovni asoslab aytdik. Endi uy vazifasi.
scenes.say: Great work. You can now compare and contrast two options and finish with a clear preference.
scenes.say_uz: Ajoyib ish. Endi ikki variantni taqqoslab, oxirida aniq tanlovingizni ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Compare living in a city vs the countryside (1 minute)
Include: 1 similarity, 2 differences, whereas/while, on the other hand
Finish: Overall, I'd choose ... because ...
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Bir daqiqalik ovoz yozuvi yozing: shaharda yashash va qishloqda yashashni solishtiring. Mezon: kamida bitta o‘xshashlik, ikkita farq, bitta ‘whereas’ yoki ‘while’, bitta ‘on the other hand’ va oxirida ‘Overall, I’d choose... because...’ bilan asoslangan tanlov bo‘lsin. Keyin tinglab, to‘rtta qolipni topib ko‘ring. Keyingi darsda hikoya qilish texnikasini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is a one-minute recording. Compare city life and country life. See you in the next lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz bir daqiqalik yozuv. Shahar va qishloq hayotini solishtiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz.

homework_uz: Bir daqiqalik ovoz yozing: shaharda va qishloqda yashashni solishtiring. Mezon: kamida bitta o‘xshashlik (both yoki neither), ikkita farq, bitta whereas yoki while, bitta on the other hand va oxirida “Overall, I’d choose … because …” bilan sababli tanlov. Yozuvni tinglab, but bilan whereas aralashmaganini va prefer … to … to‘g‘ri ishlatilganini tekshiring.

quiz.why_uz: “Neither” ijobiy fe’l bilan salbiy ma’no beradi: Neither city is cheap.

options: Tashkent is more bigger than my village.
Tashkent is very bigger than my village.
Tashkent is much bigger than my village.
Tashkent is much bigger that my village.
quiz.why_uz: Qiyoslash bilan much/far ishlatiladi; ‘more bigger’ va ‘very bigger’ xato, ‘that’ emas ‘than’.

quiz.q: Cities are noisy, ___ villages are quiet.
quiz.why_uz: Whereas qarama-qarshilik bildiradi; ‘but’ bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

options: Cities are noisy. Whereas villages are quiet.
Cities are noisy, whereas villages are quiet.
Cities are noisy whereas, villages are quiet.
Cities are noisy; whereas, villages are quiet.
quiz.why_uz: Whereas gapni bo‘laklab yubormaydi, oldiga vergul qo‘yiladi.

quiz.q: On the one hand, flats are cheap. ___, they are small.
quiz.why_uz: Qat’iy ibora: on the other hand.
Prefer A to B: ‘than’ bilan emas, ‘to’ bilan.

options: I'd rather to stay at home.
quiz.why_uz: Would rather dan keyin ‘to’ siz asosiy shakl keladi.

options: Overall, I would choose the train because it is faster.
Train is train, bus is bus.
quiz.why_uz: Yaxshi xulosa signal so‘z, tanlov va sababdan iborat.

quiz.q: Which method compares A and B on one point at a time?
quiz.why_uz: Nuqtama-nuqta usuli har mezon bo‘yicha A va B ni yonma-yon qo‘yadi.
